nodes.text: Did I miss my chance?

nodes.text: I feel pumped after our talk, $ALLISON. You should be a coach or something.

nodes.text: Hee! I just spoke from my experience.

nodes.text: That makes me feel... Good.

nodes.text: Not offended.

nodes.text: Spencer's been... Kind of obsessed with this bookstore. He keeps asking if I want to go read.

nodes.text: I don't get it. He's not a brainiac like you.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm... I'm not sure what that means.

nodes.text: I think Spencer still likes me!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Ohmygosh! I've found Brinna's weakness!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Every picture she's taken...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Is of Logan!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: On no!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'd better not. It just seems too wrong...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She left it! This is my chance!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wait... Should I do this?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! I can't believe I'm doing this!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eeeeeeeeep! This isn't going to work!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: What do you think of this top? I actually--

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Have you guys ever had the feeling like you were being watched? Because I'm getting that feeling so much right now!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh no! Did she see me?

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Eh, whatever. Let's go try these on!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Uhh, Kimi, right? What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Nothing. Just standing here.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Are you pretending to be a mannequin?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So embarrassing...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Look, maybe I am, but `please` don't say anything. It's life or death!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, maybe I am, but [color=#3b78e2][i]please[/i][/color] don't say anything. It's life or death!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Fine... Just don't break anything.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! I can't believe I'm doing this!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: This top is stuck!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eeeeeeeeeep!

nodes.speaker: Brinna

nodes.text: Phew!

nodes.speaker: Kimi

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whoop!

nodes.speaker: Kimi

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
